nodes.label: ADR 0164: GLUE Home matches the duplicates' fingerprints
nodes.rationale: Moves duplicate matching from the page's worker to GLUE Home's engine (Rust). GLUE Home's analysis already keeps fingerprints in cache. The matching happens five seconds after analysis saves results using findSameRecordings and findMatchesFor line-for-line. With GLUE Home, the page asks for matches instead of computing them, reducing full syncs.
